title: Facet load share (% of axial force) intact vs nucleotomy kinematics, with/without capsules
condition: intact and after partial nucleotomy (kinematics replayed on posterior elements)

quantity.name: facet load share
quantity.definition: sagittal-plane force transmitted over the facet joints (+- capsular ligaments) as % of applied axial force; box plot median, quartiles (q1,q3), whisker ends (min/max fields); n=8 nucleotomy-group specimens

source.authors: Ivicsics MF, Bishop NE, Puschel K, Morlock MM, Huber G
source.sample: 9 specimens (7 L4-L5, 2 L3-L4); 8 nucleotomy group + 1 L4-L5 control; 9 fresh-frozen male human lumbar FSUs (7 L4-L5, 2 L3-L4); 8 in nucleotomy group, 1 intact control

protocol.summary: Displacement-controlled sagittal-plane test (MTS Bionix + superstructure): 700 N constant axial compression, zero AP shear, sinusoidal extension-flexion +-5 deg at 0.2 Hz; 2100 preconditioning cycles; kinematics (axial, AP translation, FE angle) recorded and replayed on the same specimen after sequential removal of structures; lower vertebra on 6-axis load cell; cycles 19-24 of the third repetition evaluated. 5 deg extension not reached in all specimens (spinous process contact).
how_to_simulate: Embed FSU (disc horizontal); lower vertebra fixed on load cell; upper vertebra driven in axial, AP-shear and FE
Apply 700 N axial compression, 0 shear, +-5 deg FE sinusoid; record kinematics (intact, then after ~1 g posterolateral nucleotomy)
Replay those kinematics on the posterior elements alone (disc removed) with and without capsular ligaments
Report sagittal-plane facet force as % of applied axial force, median over max extension, max flexion, and the entire cycle
protocol.notes: Steps (order): 1 i1 = record 'intact kinematics' (3x25 cycles); 2 i2 = replay intact kinematics on intact FSU (normalisation); [nucleotomy: ~1 g nucleus (median 0.99 g, 0.73-1.71 g = 28% of nucleus) via 6-8 mm right-posterolateral horizontal incision, rongeur; then 540 re-preconditioning cycles] 3 n1 = record 'nucleotomy kinematics'; 4 n2 = replay (normalisation); [disc removed completely, cranial spinous process of lower vertebra trimmed] 5 i3 = intact kinematics applied to facets + capsular ligaments; 6 n3 = nucleotomy kinematics on facets + capsules; [capsular ligaments dissected] 7 i4 = intact kinematics on facet contact only; 8 n4 = nucleotomy kinematics on facet contact only. Values are % of the applied axial force (relative), not absolute.
